answer.reason: The verses tell what was done with the Bronze Sea: it was made and set in the temple, taken down by Ahaz, and broken up and carried to Babylon.

clauses.english: was made by Solomon as a great molten basin standing on twelve oxen
was taken down from the brasen oxen by King Ahaz and put on the stone pavement
clauses.quote: took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it

clauses.english: was broken in pieces by the Chaldees, and its brass carried to Babylon
clauses.quote: did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon

doubts: 1CH 18:8 (David's brass used for it) and 2CH 4:6 (the sea for the priests to wash in) left out as detail beyond the chief events.
JER 27:19 only names the sea among vessels and states no deed, so it was not cited.
